parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans identity, no documented border rejection, bathroom ban, police targeting of visitors or organised campaign. Against that, combined regime leaves visitor-facing exposure: trans women placed in male custody with documented abuse/survival strategies and no national remedy, recurring service refusal/exclusion with only patchwork provincial/city protection and no national enforcement, and 2025 killings described as a pattern but without rate or documented prosecutions. Local hostile ordinances exist but enforcement is not_documented. This is elevated, not reduced, risk.

entry_documents.exposure: No documented border refusal or non-recognition of foreign passports; home documents retain birth gender domestically but no documented visitor document-doubting practice.
entry_documents.interaction: Document mismatch matters mainly if police/custody encounter occurs, linking to birth-sex placement.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Documented: trans women in male dormitories at capital city jail, mandatory head-shaving, safety via inmate hierarchies and informal same-sex 'weddings' as survival strategy.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: One southern jail annex batches LGBT detainees 'to prevent abuse'; no national placement rule documented.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Detention, e.g. Pride arrests under assembly/disease statutes in 2020, would trigger birth-sex custody exposure; local variation does not remedy general practice.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: No national bathroom/facility ban documented. Two local ordinances restrict cross-dressing/dress for men/religious community, enforcement not_documented.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Nine provinces and 32+ cities/municipalities prohibit SOGI discrimination in varying coverage; penalties under social-worker, women's and safe-spaces statutes.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Patchwork protection varies by locality; national human-rights commission investigates but lacks enforcement without national law.

care_services.exposure: Not documented. No hospital ward rule, medication or emergency-care restriction for visitors documented.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: No trans-identity offence; grave-scandal provision for public sexual conduct/displays, not documented as used against trans presentation. Police arrested Pride participants in 2020 under general statutes.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: No national SOGI anti-discrimination law; equality bill stalled/rejected. Municipalities ban cross-dressing under imprisonment in text only.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: General public-order/assembly laws can be applied to LGBT gatherings, but no documented visitor targeting pattern.

minors_guardians.exposure: Not documented. No visitor-minor restriction, care or custody rule for travelling families documented.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Two trans women killed 23 June 2025, earlier murders since 2012 including armed-group killings, 2024 drag performer struck on stage, 2025 rape arrest. No denominator, so no rate derived.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Mayor apologised after drag assault; no documented prosecutions/convictions for trans attacks in dossier.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Violence in southern city linked to armed conflict/blame in displacement; visitor-specific frequency not established.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Service refusal/exclusion 'with little or no legal consequence' nationally; remedies depend on local ordinance coverage.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Patchwork ordinances and harassment/slur penalties, 32 cities/9 provinces, provide partial recourse in covered areas.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Travel-risk 2026 score 62 caution has unpublished methodology, given low weight; custody, care, ward and border-marker unknowns remain.

anchor_checks.comparison: Lower than 0.35-A: no universal birth-sex bathroom rule enforced across public buildings, no systematic police stops/extortion of visitors, and custody exposure is conditional on detention rather than routine facility exclusion.

Similar to 0.55-B: recurring service hostility and patchwork mediators/remedies, some penalties, but unresolved complaints and uneven protection; here custody harm and unproven prosecutions offset absence of facility ban.

Lower than 0.75-C: no documented traditional acceptance, court compensation actually enforced for visitor, or identity-based facilities; instead documented male-custody placement, service exclusion and killings without documented remedy.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime: national law does not criminalise trans visitors and no universal facility/border rule is documented, preventing high-risk tier. But if outed and detained, birth-sex male custody with documented abuse is a tier-1 exposure with no national remedy. Everyday risk is service refusal and violence with only locality-dependent recourse; 2025 killings signal concern but raw counts cannot establish rate or campaign. Patchwork protections mitigate in covered provinces/cities, not nationally. Net: elevated risk around 0.55.
